CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

4. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   D. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   C. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

7. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

8. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

11. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
